notes: NEW cross-source identity corroboration (not a sampled processing cohort): t-mart's explicit rank mapping and current GoldCap item pages concur Serevite Ore R1=190395, R2=190396, R3=190394; GoldCap item pages also show Draconium Ore R1=189143, R2=188658, R3=190311. These remain SECONDARY independently sourced item-rank assertions: original live in-game tooltip / Blizzard item API not inspected. No verified per-output numeric study was obtained; casts, castsWithDrop, totalQuantity, zeros, histograms, sample skill/spec/refunds, patch and item-output rank remain unknown and must NOT be filled from model averages, ore bought, or source percentages. Previously recorded original prospecting studies recognized and not duplicated. Numeric search across Reddit, Wowhead, Blizzard forum, Warcraft Wiki, GitHub and GoldCap did not identify a distinct new completed-operation cast ledger. T0046 mapping reviewer should now verify with authoritative API and reconcile any imported mistaken rank labels before estimator adoption.
